dailyBrief: DeepInfer has launched a high-performance inference framework tailored for DeepSeek models, promising to enhance efficiency in AI applications, which could significantly benefit businesses relying on deep learning technologies. Meanwhile, Anthropic reported a staggering net loss exceeding $80 billion in the first half of 2026, raising questions about sustainability and investment strategies in the AI sector. On a more positive note, OpenAI's ChatGPT Ads has expanded its reach to 26 new countries, attracting over 100,000 advertisers, indicating a growing monetization potential for AI-driven platforms.
